hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Middle East, bordering the Mediterranean Sea, between Israel and Syria || narrow coastal plain; El Beqaa (Bekaa Valley) separates Lebanon and Anti-Lebanon Mountains || smallest country in continental Asia; Nahr el Litani is the only major river in Near East not crossing an international boundary || Resources: limestone, iron ore, salt, water-surplus state in a water-deficit region, arable land || Exports: jewelry, cars, diamonds, scrap iron, gold (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: narrow coastal plain; El Beqaa (Bekaa Valley) separates Lebanon and Anti-Lebanon Mountains || Middle East, bordering the Mediterranean Sea, between Israel and Syria

climate.excerpt: Mediterranean; mild to cool, wet winters with hot, dry summers; the Lebanon Mountains experience heavy winter snows || earthquakes; dust storms, sandstorms

economy.excerpt: lower middle-income Middle Eastern economy; hyperinflation and sharp poverty increases; banks have ceased lending; economic contraction, destroyed infrastructure, and reduced consumer demand resulting from Israel-Hezbollah conflict || Exports: jewelry, cars, diamonds, scrap iron, gold (2023) || Industries: banking, tourism, real estate and construction, food processing, wine, jewelry, cement, textiles, mineral and chemical products, wood and furniture products, oil refining, metal fabricating

peopleAndCulture.excerpt: Muslim 67.8% (31.9% Sunni, 31.2% Shia, smaller percentages of Alawites and Ismailis), Christian 32.4% (Maronite Catholics are the largest Christian group), Druze 4.5%, very small numbers of Jews, Baha'is, Buddhists, and Hindus (2020 est.) || Arab 95%, Armenian 4%, other 1%
